criteria.label: Inventories, reviews, imports, and validates scenarios through the canonical SDK lifecycle
Rejects answer leakage, shallow routing checks, provenance-only signals, and unscoreable tile tasks
Keeps dry-run, live Tessl, Registry, install, and repo validation evidence lanes separate

delegation.rationale: Scenario generation benefits from automated inventory and drafting, but promotion to canonical evals or live Tessl spend requires human-reviewable evidence and explicit readiness gates.

learning_posture.rationale: Default to guided mode when changing eval contracts or Tessl staging mechanics; execute only after repo evidence and run-budget boundaries are established.
